title: SkillProof Backend Skill Catalog
description: Comprehensive competency taxonomy and language classification for backend engineering career readiness.

competencies.name: Programming Fundamentals
competencies.description: Core computer science principles, data structure selection, algorithmic complexity, error handling, and clean modular code design.

subskills.name: Data Structure Selection
subskills.description: Selecting optimal data structures (hash tables, trees, lists, heaps) based on time/space access patterns.

subskills.name: Algorithmic Complexity & Big-O
subskills.description: Evaluating and optimizing time and space complexity for computation and data processing.

subskills.name: Object-Oriented & Modular Design
subskills.description: Applying SOLID principles, dependency inversion, clean separation of concerns, and cohesion.

subskills.name: Error & Exception Handling
subskills.description: Designing robust exception hierarchies, boundary error handling, and fault containment.

competencies.name: REST API Design & HTTP
competencies.description: Architecting reliable, standards-compliant RESTful web services, HTTP semantics, idempotency, and resource contracts.

subskills.name: HTTP Semantics & Idempotency
subskills.description: Understanding HTTP verbs (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE), status codes, and idempotency guarantees.

subskills.name: Resource Modeling & API Contracts
subskills.description: Designing predictable REST resource URIs, payload schemas, and backward-compatible contract evolution.

subskills.name: Pagination, Filtering & Sorting
subskills.description: Implementing offset-based and keyset/cursor-based pagination for performant dataset querying.

subskills.name: Concurrency Control & Headers
subskills.description: Using ETags, If-Match headers, and optimistic concurrency for safe concurrent resource updates.

competencies.name: SQL & Relational Databases
competencies.description: Relational data modeling, query optimization, indexing internals, execution plan analysis, and ACID transaction semantics.

subskills.name: Schema Design & Constraints
subskills.description: Designing normalized relational schemas with foreign keys, uniqueness, and check constraints.

subskills.name: Complex Queries, Joins & Aggregations
subskills.description: Authoring multi-table joins, subqueries, grouping aggregations, and window functions.

subskills.name: Indexing & Query Execution Plans
subskills.description: Analyzing EXPLAIN query plans, B-Tree index selectivity, covering indexes, and scan-vs-seek costs.

subskills.name: Transactions & ACID Isolation
subskills.description: Managing atomic transactions, lock escalation, isolation levels, and concurrency anomalies.

competencies.name: Automated Testing & Quality
competencies.description: Automated test suites, unit testing fundamentals, dependency isolation with mocks, integration testing, and test determinism.

subskills.name: Unit Testing & Assertions
subskills.description: Authoring isolated unit tests validating business logic, boundary values, and invariants.

subskills.name: Test Doubles & Dependency Mocking
subskills.description: Isolating external services, databases, and third-party APIs using mocks, stubs, and fakes.

subskills.name: Integration & API Testing
subskills.description: Testing API endpoints and persistence layers against ephemeral databases and realistic test environments.

subskills.name: Test Determinism & Edge Cases
subskills.description: Eliminating flaky tests, race conditions, and asserting negative paths and transient error handling.

competencies.name: Authentication & API Security
competencies.description: Identity verification, token lifecycles, cryptographic signature verification, authorization models, and API vulnerability mitigation.

subskills.name: JWT & Token Lifecycle Management
subskills.description: Generating, cryptographically verifying, and rotating access and refresh tokens.

subskills.name: Authorization Models (RBAC & ABAC)
subskills.description: Enforcing role-based and attribute-based permissions across endpoints and data layers.

subskills.name: Token Revocation & Session Invalidation
subskills.description: Managing token blacklists, refresh token rotation, and immediate user revocation.

subskills.name: OWASP API Vulnerability Mitigation
subskills.description: Preventing Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA), injection, and unauthorized data exposure.

competencies.name: System Design & Architecture
competencies.description: Designing scalable, resilient, and maintainable backend architectures, stateless services, rate limiting, and failure containment.

subskills.name: Stateless Service Design & Horizontal Scaling
subskills.description: Designing shared-nothing stateless application tiers capable of horizontal load-balanced scaling.

subskills.name: Rate Limiting & Traffic Throttling
subskills.description: Implementing distributed token bucket and sliding-window rate limiters to protect service availability.

subskills.name: Caching Strategies & Invalidation
subskills.description: Applying cache-aside, write-through, TTL invalidation, and mitigating thundering herd problems.

subskills.name: Resilience & Failure Mitigation
subskills.description: Designing circuit breakers, retries with exponential backoff, dead-letter queues, and graceful degradation.

competencies.name: NoSQL Data Stores
competencies.description: Document, key-value, and wide-column data stores, schema design tradeoffs, and CAP theorem consistency models.

subskills.name: Document Databases
subskills.description: Modeling semi-structured data, indexing nested documents, and querying in stores like MongoDB.

subskills.name: CAP Theorem & Eventual Consistency
subskills.description: Evaluating consistency vs. availability tradeoffs in distributed data stores.

competencies.name: Distributed Caching
competencies.description: In-memory distributed key-value stores (e.g. Redis, Memcached), data structures, and eviction policies.

subskills.name: Redis Data Types & Operations
subskills.description: Utilizing strings, hashes, sorted sets, and atomic Lua scripts for distributed caching and state.

subskills.name: Cache Eviction & Expiry Policies
subskills.description: Configuring LRU, LFU, TTL policies, and managing memory pressure in caching tiers.

competencies.name: Version Control (Git)
competencies.description: Distributed version control, branching strategies, rebase workflows, and collaborative code integration.

subskills.name: Branching & Gitflow
subskills.description: Managing feature branches, pull request workflows, and release branching.

subskills.name: Merging, Rebasing & Conflict Resolution
subskills.description: Resolving complex merge conflicts and maintaining clean linear commit histories.

competencies.name: Containerization (Docker)
competencies.description: Containerizing backend services, multi-stage builds, container networking, and local compose orchestration.

subskills.name: Multi-Stage Dockerfiles
subskills.description: Writing lean, secure multi-stage Dockerfiles minimizing production container image size.

subskills.name: Docker Compose Local Environment
subskills.description: Orchestrating multi-container local development environments (API, database, cache).

competencies.name: CI/CD Pipelines
competencies.description: Automated build, test, and continuous deployment workflows, artifact versioning, and environment promotion.

subskills.name: Automated Test & Build Pipelines
subskills.description: Configuring GitHub Actions or GitLab CI to build, lint, and test on every pull request.

subskills.name: Deployment Strategies
subskills.description: Understanding blue-green, rolling, and canary deployments with automated rollback.

competencies.name: Concurrency & Asynchronous Programming
competencies.description: Thread management, asynchronous I/O, event loops, race condition prevention, and non-blocking pipelines.

subskills.name: Asynchronous I/O & Non-Blocking Execution
subskills.description: Using async/await and non-blocking I/O to maximize throughput on high-concurrency servers.

subskills.name: Thread Safety & Synchronization
subskills.description: Preventing race conditions, deadlocks, and coordinating concurrent access to shared resources.

competencies.name: Message Queues & Event-Driven Systems
competencies.description: Asynchronous messaging, pub/sub architectures, message brokers (RabbitMQ, Kafka), and idempotent consumers.

subskills.name: Pub/Sub & Queue Architecture
subskills.description: Decoupling services using message queues, topic exchanges, and asynchronous worker pools.

subskills.name: Idempotent Processing & Dead-Letter Handling
subskills.description: Ensuring message processing idempotency and capturing poison pills in dead-letter queues.

competencies.name: Observability, Logging & Monitoring
competencies.description: Structured logging, metrics collection, distributed request tracing, and production health monitoring.

subskills.name: Structured Contextual Logging
subskills.description: Emitting machine-parseable JSON logs with correlation IDs across distributed service calls.

subskills.name: Metrics & Distributed Tracing
subskills.description: Tracking latency percentiles (p95, p99), error rates, and OpenTelemetry distributed traces.

languages.name: C# / .NET
languages.description: Object-oriented, strongly typed language on the .NET runtime widely used for enterprise backend web APIs.

subskills.name: Async/Await & Task Parallelism
subskills.description: Managing Tasks, ValueTask, CancellationTokens, and async enumerable streams.

subskills.name: ASP.NET Core Architecture
subskills.description: Middleware pipeline, dependency injection container, and Minimal API configuration.

subskills.name: LINQ & Memory Optimization
subskills.description: Expression trees, deferred execution, and struct/Span memory efficiency.

languages.name: Java
languages.description: Class-based, object-oriented language on the JVM powering large-scale distributed enterprise backends.

subskills.name: Spring Boot & Dependency Injection
subskills.description: Inversion of control container, Spring Data repositories, and Spring Security.

subskills.name: JVM Concurrency & Garbage Collection
subskills.description: ExecutorService, virtual threads (Project Loom), and garbage collection tuning.

languages.name: Python
languages.description: Interpreted, dynamic language with high developer velocity commonly used with FastAPI, Django, and async backends.

subskills.name: FastAPI & AsyncIO
subskills.description: Asynchronous route handlers, Pydantic data validation, and event loop execution.

subskills.name: GIL & Multiprocessing
subskills.description: Overcoming Global Interpreter Lock bottlenecks using worker processes and Celery tasks.

languages.name: C++
languages.description: High-performance compiled language providing deterministic resource control and low-latency system programming.

subskills.name: RAII & Smart Pointers
subskills.description: Deterministic memory management, unique_ptr, shared_ptr, and move semantics.

subskills.name: STL & Concurrency Primitives
subskills.description: Modern C++ standard template library, mutexes, condition variables, and atomics.

languages.name: JavaScript (Node.js)
languages.description: Event-driven, single-threaded runtime executing asynchronous non-blocking I/O for web services.

subskills.name: Node.js Event Loop & Non-Blocking I/O
subskills.description: Microtasks, macrotasks, and preventing event loop starvation.

subskills.name: Streams & Buffer Processing
subskills.description: Handling backpressure and streaming large file uploads and downloads.

languages.name: TypeScript
languages.description: Typed superset of JavaScript providing static compile-time type safety for scalable backend codebases.

subskills.name: Generics & Utility Types
subskills.description: Conditional types, mapped types, discriminated unions, and type narrowing.

subskills.name: Runtime Validation Integration
subskills.description: Integrating TypeScript types with runtime validation libraries like Zod or TypeBox.

languages.name: Go (Golang)
languages.description: Compiled, statically typed language engineered at Google for concurrent, scalable network services.

subskills.name: Goroutines & Channels
subskills.description: CSP concurrency patterns, channel synchronization, and select multiplexing.

subskills.name: Structural Typing & Composition
subskills.description: Implicit interface implementation and composable package architecture.

languages.name: Rust
languages.description: Systems programming language delivering memory safety without a garbage collector via ownership and borrow checking.

subskills.name: Ownership, Borrowing & Lifetimes
subskills.description: Compile-time memory safety, mutable references, and lifetime annotations.

subskills.name: Async Rust & Tokio
subskills.description: Future polling, Tokio runtime tasks, and fear-free concurrency with Send and Sync.
